features.title: One platform. Your whole business on autopilot.
features.sub: Smart modules that answer, schedule, sell and organize, so you can focus on growing your company.

cards.c1text: Your customers book, reschedule or cancel appointments right from the chat. Native integration with Google Calendar and Google Meet, with automatic confirmations and reminders. No more phone calls and schedule clashes.
cards.c2text: It answers frequent questions, guides the customer and keeps your brand's tone, in natural language, at any hour of the day or night, without breaks or holidays.
cards.c3text: It captures the details, totals them up and registers the order automatically, with no manual work.
cards.c4text: Share photos, videos, catalogs and PDFs automatically during the conversation.
cards.c5text: Every conversation tags itself according to its intent, so you can prioritize what matters.

sectors.title: If you serve customers over WhatsApp, Mocter is for you
sectors.sub: Whatever your sector: if you book appointments, answer questions or sell, the AI automates it for you.

how.title: Your AI assistant, ready in 3 steps
how.sub: No app to install. Your customers keep messaging your same WhatsApp as always.

steps.s1text: We link your business number with the official WhatsApp API and your Google Calendar in minutes.
steps.s2text: We load your services, hours, prices and brand tone. The AI learns exactly how your company works.
steps.s3text: The AI answers, schedules and organizes. You see everything in your dashboard with real-time metrics.

visual.v1text: Your usual number, now supercharged with AI and connected to your calendar.
visual.v2text: It talks like your brand: friendly, formal or professional, you set the tone.
visual.v3text: Appointments, replies and orders running by themselves, 24 hours a day.

demo.title: Every contact, organized and moving on its own

items.q1: Does it work for my type of business?
items.a1: Yes. Mocter adapts to any company that serves customers over WhatsApp: clinics, salons, consultancies, real estate, schools, technical services, retail, restaurants and more. We configure the AI for your sector.
items.a2: The AI checks your availability on Google Calendar, offers the open time slots, confirms the appointment, creates the Google Meet link (if applicable) and sends automatic reminders. All from the chat.
items.q3: Do my customers have to download anything?
items.a3: No. They keep texting your same WhatsApp as always. The AI replies behind the scenes without them noticing any change.
items.q4: Does the AI sound like a robot?
items.a4: Not at all. We define your brand's tone and personality (friendly, formal, with emojis, etc.) so it speaks exactly how you want.
items.a5: 100% on servers in Colombia. You always keep ownership of your information and we comply with local data protection.
items.q6: Can I take over a chat manually?
items.a6: Yes. Whenever you want, a human on your team can step into the conversation from the unified inbox.
